title: Live-Action Legends
intro: [excited] Lights, camera, ACTION! Welcome to Live-Action Legends, where the stars are real people... flying nannies, identical twins and at least one very sweaty pirate. Let's roll!

art.prompt: A golden-age Hollywood soundstage with a director's chair, a vintage film camera, a parrot-handled umbrella resting on a pirate treasure chest and a London rooftop set glowing under studio lights, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: A Spoonful of Sugar
categories.intro: Our film category is A Spoonful of Sugar, all about 1964's Mary Poppins. [chuckles] Practically perfect clues, if I do say so myself.

art.prompt: Victorian London rooftops at sunset with smoking chimneys, a floating black umbrella, a carpetbag, kites drifting over St. Paul's dome and pigeons on a step, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Mary Poppins floats down from the sky onto Cherry Tree Lane holding on to this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an umbrella! And it has a talking parrot head handle. [laughs] Way better than an airplane, and no baggage fees.

clues.clue: Mary's cheerful chimney sweep friend, Bert, is played by this legendary comic actor.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dick Van Dyke! [chuckles] He also played old Mr. Dawes Senior in a second role. And yes... about that accent.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins says this super-long song title is something to say when you have nothing to say.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious! [laughs] Try saying it backwards. Dociousaliexpilistic... you know what, never mind.

clues.clue: In Feed the Birds, the old Bird Woman on the steps of St. Paul's sells crumbs for this price per bag.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is tuppence! [sighs] Walt Disney said Feed the Birds was his favorite song. The Sherman Brothers played it for him on Friday afternoons.

clues.clue: When Mary Poppins measures herself with her magic tape measure, it reads this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is practically perfect in every way! [mischievously] Michael's said extremely stubborn and suspicious. Accurate, honestly.

categories.title: Double Trouble
categories.intro: Next up, Double Trouble! Twins, body swaps and family chaos. [laughs] You'll be seeing double by the end of this.

art.prompt: A split-screen summer scene: a lakeside summer camp cabin with canoes on one side and a London townhouse on the other, two matching suitcases and two fortune cookies in the middle, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Freaky Friday, a mother and her teenage daughter magically do this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is switch bodies! [laughs] Suddenly Mom has to go to high school and the kid has to go to work. Nobody wins.

clues.clue: In the 1998 Parent Trap, Lindsay Lohan plays twins Annie and this sister from California.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hallie! Annie is the proper Londoner, Hallie the California girl. [chuckles] And they're both Lindsay Lohan.

clues.clue: The 1998 Parent Trap twins first meet at this summer camp in Maine.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Camp Walden! [mischievously] They pull pranks, they go to isolation, they find out they're sisters. Classic camp.

clues.clue: In the original 1961 Parent Trap, this British actress played both twins, Susan and Sharon.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hayley Mills! [excited] And she sang Let's Get Together too. Double the twins, double the fun.

clues.clue: In the 1976 Freaky Friday, the daughter, Annabel, is played by this future two-time Oscar winner.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jodie Foster! [gasps] Her mom was Barbara Harris. Then in 2003, Lindsay Lohan and Jamie Lee Curtis swapped again.

categories.title: Prop Department
categories.intro: It's our picture category, Prop Department! I'll show you a scene full of props from a Disney live-action film. [excited] Name the movie!

art.prompt: A dusty movie studio prop warehouse full of treasure chests, flying beds, glowing neon gadgets and a vintage car on shelves, warm dramatic light, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Name the Disney live-action film this scene evokes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hocus Pocus! [mischievously] Never light the black flame candle. Especially not in Salem. Especially not on Halloween.

media.prompt: A spooky colonial Salem cottage at night on Halloween, a bubbling iron cauldron, a stitched leather spell book with a strange eye on the cover, and a single black candle with an eerie green flame, original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos

clues.clue: Name the Disney live-action film this scene evokes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Enchanted! [laughs] A storybook well that drops you into Times Square. Worst commute ever.

clues.clue: Name the Disney live-action film this scene evokes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bedknobs and Broomsticks! [excited] A flying brass bed and an apprentice witch. Substitutiary locomotion!

clues.clue: Name the Disney live-action film this scene evokes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tron! [gasps] 1982, and one of the first movies to use computer graphics in a big way. Ride its light cycle coaster at Magic Kingdom.

media.prompt: An endless glowing digital landscape of neon blue grid lines, a glowing disc spinning in mid-air and a sleek light-trail motorcycle streak across black space, original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos

clues.clue: Name the 1961 Disney live-action film this scene evokes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Absent-Minded Professor! [laughs] Flying rubber and a flying Model T. It was remade in 1997 as Flubber.

media.prompt: A cluttered 1960s college science lab with a bubbling beaker of bouncy green goo, a basketball floating mid-air, and a black vintage Model T car flying over a small-town college at night, original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos

categories.title: Rides to the Big Screen
categories.intro: Time for the parks: Rides to the Big Screen! These attractions became movies. [whispers] And some of them were... better than others.

art.prompt: A theme park ride boat and a haunted hotel elevator drifting into a giant glowing movie screen in a dark theater, popcorn floating in the air, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: This Disneyland boat ride, which opened in 1967, inspired a blockbuster movie franchise starring Johnny Depp.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pirates of the Caribbean! [laughs] It was the last ride Walt Disney personally worked on. Yo ho, yo ho!

clues.clue: The 2021 Jungle Cruise movie starred Dwayne Johnson as skipper Frank and this actress as Lily.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Emily Blunt! [chuckles] Bonus: Dwayne Johnson told the classic skipper puns. The backside of water, people!

clues.clue: The 2003 Haunted Mansion movie starred this comedian as a real estate agent.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Eddie Murphy! [mischievously] Another movie followed in 2023. The mansion has 999 happy haunts, and room for one more.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's musical bear show inspired this 2002 movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Country Bears! [laughs] Not exactly a box office smash. But Big Al still has fans.

clues.clue: The Tower of Terror inspired a 1997 TV movie starring Kirsten Dunst and this actor.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Steve Guttenberg! [gasps] It aired on The Wonderful World of Disney, three years after the Florida ride opened in 1994. Going... DOWN!

categories.title: Real-Life Royalty
categories.intro: Our fan category is Real-Life Royalty: princesses, pirate queens and wicked queens, all played by real people. [excited] Curtsy and buzz in!

art.prompt: A palace ballroom where a jeweled tiara, a pirate captain's hat and a wicked queen's crown sit on velvet pillows, a magic mirror glowing in the background, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Enchanted, Giselle falls through a magic well from Andalasia and lands in this real city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is New York City! [laughs] She wanders into Times Square in a gigantic wedding dress. Somehow nobody blinks.

clues.clue: Captain Jack Sparrow's beloved ship with black sails.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Black Pearl! [mischievously] The fastest ship in the Caribbean... when Jack can actually keep it.

clues.clue: In Enchanted, Giselle cleans a messy apartment with pigeons, rats and cockroaches while singing this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Happy Working Song! [laughs] A loving parody of Whistle While You Work, but with New York wildlife. Ew. Adorable, but ew.

clues.clue: In The Princess Diaries, Mia Thermopolis learns she is heir to the throne of this European country.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Genovia! [chuckles] Her grandmother, the queen, is played by Julie Andrews. Mary Poppins herself, giving princess lessons.

clues.clue: Enchanted's wicked Queen Narissa is played by this Oscar-winning actress.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Susan Sarandon! [excited] She ends the film as a giant dragon on top of the Woolworth Building. As one does.
